newsitem.title: JAPAN: Kobe rubber futures mixed in after-hours trade.
newsitem.headline: Kobe rubber futures mixed in after-hours trade.

text.p: Kobe rubber futures were mixed in after-hours trade on Monday after drifting a tad easier in extremely thin trade during the day, traders said.
Prices ranged from 0.5 yen per kilogram lower to 0.3 yen firmer than the day's close. The benchmark May contract was 0.3 yen firmer at 141.5 yen. Volume was 2,713 lots.

During the day, prices opened firmer, backed by the yen's weaker tendency, but a lack of follow-through buying sent most prices into negative territory by the day's close. "Weaker overseas markets could drag prices down," one trader said.
